source_evidence: Player exact 'oo yes the veteren' confirms previous Vex main and bonus attack on adjacent Veteran, not dead captain, and prior Cirren no Spirit Guardians instruction. V main melee Psychic Blade +7, Vex1MP7→6, ally Fenar adjacent veteran qualifies Sneak Attack: actual d20 12+7=19 hit AC17, d6 1+4+2d6(5,6)=16 psychic, Veteran58→42. Vex advantage bonus d20 13,6 choose13+7=20 hit, d4 3+4=7 psychic,42→35. Cirren uses no spell slot; Toll the Dead WIS save10+0=10/DC16 fail, 2d12(6,9)=15 necrotic,35→20; BA moves existing Spiritual Weapon20ft from(55,0) toward veteran to(35,-15), no target within reach at that point so no attack. Veteran, leader dead/allies fleeing, Disengages and moves30ft to(55,-15) rather than suicide attack. Fenar independently intercepts from(30,-10) to(50,-15), existing Rage, Reckless: mechanical greataxe visual paired Double-Claw Rend d20 11,9 choose11+8=19 hit AC17, d12 12+7=19 slashing,20→1; Beast claw adv nat20,16 critical, 2d6(5,2)+7=14 slashing,1→0 DEAD. No extra claw or Shift. Remaining scouts/thugs continue retreat Dashes60ft, no pursuit or further hostile action; immediate fight ends with five alive fleeing, not automatically killed/captured. Actual receipt IDs f44c5302c85e043954ef6823c00bcd40 and d49026491d6c005884459b9424d700e2, all HP/resources unchanged except explicit MP expenditure; no fabricated rolls or additional V action. D321~10:31:12 Ossent frontier road, immediate combat concluded R2 after V and allies defeat veteran. V(20,-15) HP48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP6/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge0/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned, R2 action and BA spent, no reaction spent; not hidden. Cirren(35,10) HP51/51 AC18 HD6/6 slots4/2/3 CD2/2, Spiritual Weapon repositioned toward veteran by20ft to(35,-15) without attack, active nonconcentration through R10 (one minute from R1); no Spirit Guardians, no new slot. Fenar(50,-15) HP59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage3/4 active magical Beast claws, Reckless through next turn, Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40; no extra use. Captain dead(35,-10), veteran dead(55,-15), remaining five raiders fled another60ft west from R1 positions, S1(160,25),S2(160,-25),S3(190,25),T1(175,8),T2(175,-8); full HP, retreating independently, no new attack or pursuit, no automatic capture/escape guarantee if V pursues. Mara(-45,-5) and merchant near(-35,0), both vehicles and all horses healthy, no wool or money surrendered. Purse3178gp4sp6cp, provisions9/12 before D321 full-day debit, LR0/6, encounter count2/5 consecutive2, no D321 night roll, D322 mandatory quiet. No XP, reward, corpse search, loot, rest or further travel yet; no evidence, quests or commitments changed. V dice delegated until stop. Await V decision whether to pursue, search, speak with merchant or continue road.
